Definition: strong (usu. in a bad sense, hard, bold, violent)
BiblicalUsage: This word is strength, the strong and mighty hand, and it is always God's hand in these verses. Pharaoh lets Israel go by a strong hand and drives them out by a strong hand, the nations hear of God's strong hand and stretched out arm, and Moses shows all that mighty hand in the sight of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the strong hand is the whole story of the Exodus in one phrase: God does not persuade Pharaoh, He overpowers him. His strength is what sets His people free.
RelatedEvents: Moses and Aaron Confront Pharaoh; Building of Solomon's Temple; The Death of Moses
